issue.title: BulletPropertyPickerModal onClose never runs the Task Card cleanup (shadowed duplicate onClose)

task_type_fields.impact: Probably low. Each Ctrl+Shift+P builds a new modal instance, so stale classes or flags only matter if a closed instance is reopened or keeps receiving async callbacks, for example a link resolution that finishes after close. The dead code is misleading, though: it looks like close-time cleanup that never runs.
task_type_fields.repro: `git show c1762af^:plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys/main.js | sed -n '/^class BulletPropertyPickerModal/,$p' | grep -n '^  onClose()'` prints two matches (class-relative lines 680 and 3156). On the current tree, the live `BulletPropertyPickerModal.prototype.onClose` (src/350-picker-task-card.js) contains no `removeClass("bob-task-card-modal")`, `linkResolving = false`, or `taskCardDispatching = false`. Behavioral repro: open the Task Card (Ctrl+Shift+P), close it, and inspect `picker.modalEl.classList` / `picker.linkResolving` on the same instance. The task-card classes and flags are still set.

issue.creation_reason: The bob-cli-47.3 split found that a duplicate onClose has silently disabled the Task Card close cleanup since c0ff974. The split preserved current behavior, so the latent defect needs its own fix.

payload.entry: Fixed in bob-plugins c07b125 (batch 11 phase bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.5.6.6.6.2): the live BulletPropertyPickerModal onClose in plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys/src/350-picker-task-card.js now removes bob-task-card-modal/bob-task-card-wide and resets linkResolving/taskCardDispatching before super.onClose(), without reordering route-cancel or review-settle; no duplicate onClose remains. Lander verified the source on master 04c61c7, re-ran scripts/test-navigation-hotkeys-picker-lifecycle.cjs (18/18 pass, including the new open/close cleanup test), and confirmed vault bob-navigation-hotkeys 2.56.4 main.js is byte-identical to the repo.
